test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 20 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following statements is correct about non-biodegradable substances?

options.text: None-biodegradable substances can easily be degraded by enzymes.
Non-biodegradable substances don't harm the members of the ecosystem.
Non-biodegradable substances persist in the environment.
Non-biodegradable substances take lesser time for degradation.

solution:
The correct answer is **__Non- biodegradable substances persist in the environment.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Non** **biodegradable** : 

 
 
• Any waste or substances which can not decomposed by any natural sources and act as source of a pollution .
 
• Glass, metals, electronic devices, computer parts, batteries, medical waste, plastic bags, plastic bottles, tetra packs, and carbon paper are a few examples of non- biodegradable materials.
 
• It is usually seen that non-biodegradable substances are chemically synthesized and does not occur naturally.
 
• As the degradation rate of non-biodegradable waste is slow and the separation and recycling are not easy and expensive too.
 
 
 
• **Biodegradable:** 
 
 
• Biodegradable wastes are those substances that degrade or break down naturally. Human waste, manure, sewage, sewage sludge and slaughterhouse waste.
 
• Biodegradable waste are not accumulated but are used up in a short time
 
• Biodegradable waste becomes part of biogeochemical cycles and give back rapid turnover.
 
• After degradation, the biodegradable substances can be used to produce biogas, manure, fertilizers, compost etc.**​**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ** Biodegradable Applications****:** Biodegradable materials are those that can be decomposed by bacteria or other natural organisms. 
 
• ** Packaging Materials**: Bio-based packaging materials have been introduced as a green alternative. Edible films have gained more attention due to their environmentally friendly characteristics, vast variety and availability, non-toxicity, and low cost.
 
• ** Medical Products**: Biodegradable polymers are used in tissue engineering scaffolds, controlled drug release systems, plasma replacements, and temporary prosthetic implants.
 
• ** Agricultural Materials**: These include films and seed coatings.
